# Report information

Focused **quantitative-data** report (log2(Area) correlation and Area %CV) for
immunopeptidomics experiments.

`r HowMaHiCo::provider_line(params$Provider)`

**Sample Set:** `r params$SampleSet`

**Data Analysis: ** `r params$DataAnalysisNames`

**Date:**  `r Sys.Date()`

**Code version:** `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")`

```{r child = system.file("rmarkdown", "shared", "setup.Rmd", package = "HowMaHiCo")}
```


# Correlation log2(Area) {.tabset}

Pearson correlation using pairwise complete-observations

```{r corr-log2area-data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Get Log2Area matrices; NAs are kept as NA; mean is calculated if needed
## all peptides
pep_all_log2area_tr  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, PeptideID, Sample)
pep_all_log2area_br  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, PeptideID, BioReplicate)
prot_all_log2area_tr <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, ProteinFirst, Sample)
prot_all_log2area_br <- get_mat_log2area(pep_all, ProteinFirst, BioReplicate)
## short peptides
pep_short_log2area_tr  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, PeptideID, Sample)
pep_short_log2area_br  <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, PeptideID, BioReplicate)
prot_short_log2area_tr <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, ProteinFirst, Sample)
prot_short_log2area_br <- get_mat_log2area(pep_short, ProteinFirst, BioReplicate)

# Initialise so the export block can test for them when a plot was skipped (all-NA)
p_corr_log2area_all <- p_corr_log2area_short <- NULL
```


## All peptides

```{r plot-corr-all, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Matrix of log2(Area)
# Guard first: with no quantified peptide at all (Areas absent or every Area 0)
# get_mat_log2area() yields a 0-row matrix, and cor() on it errors ("'x' is
# empty") before the all-NA check further down could report the problem.
corr_log2area_all <- if (nrow(pep_all_log2area_tr) == 0) NULL else
  cor(pep_all_log2area_tr, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

#setup limits
corrarea_lim <- if (is.null(corr_log2area_all) || all(is.na(corr_log2area_all))) c(0, 1) else
  c(floor(min(corr_log2area_all, na.rm = TRUE)), ceiling(max(corr_log2area_all, na.rm = TRUE)))

corrarea_mid <- ifelse(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1)), 0, 0.7)
if(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1))){
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, 0.2)
}else {
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(0, 1, 0.1)
}


if(is.null(corr_log2area_all) || all(is.na(corr_log2area_all))){
  warning("Correlation plot cannot be generated: no non-missing Log2Area correlation. ",
          "Maybe the Areas were not included, or they are all zero.")
}else{
  p_corr_log2area_all <-
  corr_log2area_all |>
  plot_corr() +
  ggtitle("Log2Area correlation for all peptides")

ggplotly(p_corr_log2area_all)
}


```


## Selected peptides `r paste0("(", shortpep_range[1]," to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)")`

```{r plot-corr-short, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Guard first: with no quantified peptide at all (Areas absent or every Area 0)
# get_mat_log2area() yields a 0-row matrix, and cor() on it errors ("'x' is
# empty") before the all-NA check further down could report the problem.
corr_log2area_short <- if (nrow(pep_short_log2area_tr) == 0) NULL else
  cor(pep_short_log2area_tr, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
#setup limits
corrarea_lim <- if (is.null(corr_log2area_short) || all(is.na(corr_log2area_short))) c(0, 1) else
  c(floor(min(corr_log2area_short, na.rm = TRUE)), ceiling(max(corr_log2area_short, na.rm = TRUE)))

corrarea_mid <- ifelse(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1)), 0, 0.7)
if(all(corrarea_lim == c(-1,1))){
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, 0.2)
}else {
  corrarea_breaks <- seq(0, 1, 0.1)
}




if(is.null(corr_log2area_short) || all(is.na(corr_log2area_short))){
  warning("Correlation plot cannot be generated: no non-missing Log2Area correlation. ",
          "Maybe the Areas were not included, or they are all zero.")
}else{
p_corr_log2area_short<-
  corr_log2area_short |>
  plot_corr() +
    ggtitle(paste0("Log2Area correlation for selected peptides (", shortpep_range[1]," to ", shortpep_range[2], " AAs)"))

ggplotly(p_corr_log2area_short)
}
```


# Area CV violin plots {.tabset}

```{r areacv-data, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
pep_all_summ_area_cond <- summarise_area(pep_all, Condition)
pep_all_summ_area_biorep <- summarise_area(pep_all,  BioReplicate)
pep_short_summ_area_cond <- summarise_area(pep_short, Condition)
pep_short_summ_area_biorep <- summarise_area(pep_short,  BioReplicate)
# Initialise to NULL so the print chunks below have something to test against
# when a branch is skipped (no replicates) instead of an undefined-object error.
pviolin_areacv_cond_all <- pviolin_areacv_cond_short <-
  pviolin_areacv_biorep_all <- pviolin_areacv_biorep_short <- NULL
if(all(is.na(pep_all_summ_area_cond$Area_CV))){
  warning("Area CV plots cannot be generated for conditions. No replicates found")
}else{
  pviolin_areacv_cond_all  <- plot_violin_areacv(pep_all_summ_area_cond, Condition)
  pviolin_areacv_cond_short  <- plot_violin_areacv(pep_short_summ_area_cond, Condition)
}
if(all(is.na(pep_all_summ_area_biorep$Area_CV))){
  warning("Area CV plots cannot be generated for BioReplicates. No replicates found")
}else{
  pviolin_areacv_biorep_all  <- plot_violin_areacv(pep_all_summ_area_biorep, BioReplicate)
  pviolin_areacv_biorep_short  <- plot_violin_areacv(pep_short_summ_area_biorep, BioReplicate)
}
```

```{r export-results, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_input_params(params, folder = FolderResults, prefix = paste(c(result_prefix, "04_quant"), collapse = "_"))

if (params$CsvSave) {
  write.csv_rawr(pep_all_log2area_tr, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(pep_all_log2area_br, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(prot_all_log2area_tr, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(prot_all_log2area_br, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(pep_short_log2area_tr, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(pep_short_log2area_br, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(prot_short_log2area_tr, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
  write.csv_rawr(prot_short_log2area_br, folder = FolderResults, prefix = result_prefix)
}

if (params$PlotsSave) {
  if (!is.null(p_corr_log2area_all))
    ggsave_rawr(p_corr_log2area_all, file = "p_corr_log2area_all", folder = FolderFigures, width = 20, height = 20)
  if (!is.null(p_corr_log2area_short))
    ggsave_rawr(p_corr_log2area_short, file = "p_corr_log2area_short", folder = FolderFigures, width = 22, height = 22)
  for (nm in c("pviolin_areacv_cond_all", "pviolin_areacv_biorep_all",
               "pviolin_areacv_cond_short", "pviolin_areacv_biorep_short")) {
    obj <- get(nm)
    if (!is.null(obj)) ggsave_rawr(obj, file = nm, folder = FolderFigures, width = 12, height = 8)
  }
}
```
